meanings.en: to beat, to hit, to strike
meanings.note: Used as an imperfective (ongoing/repeated action) verb meaning 'to beat, to hit', paired with 'побить'.

examples.text: Почему меня все бьют в этом доме?

examples.text: Тише, Ваня, осторожно! Зачем ты бьёшь дерево ногой?
examples.trans: Easy, Vanya, be careful! Why are you kicking the tree with your foot?

meanings.note: in questions: а вдруг...? = and what if...?
А вдруг... = what if. Core Russian adv meaning 'suddenly; all of a sudden' in everyday speech.

examples.trans: Why did it suddenly draw level?

examples.text: Почему он вдруг сравнялся? Мы шли впереди на десять процентов!
examples.trans: Why did it suddenly draw level? We were ten percent ahead!

meanings.note: Reflexive/intransitive verb with the postfix '-ся'/'-сь' (historically from the reflexive pronoun 'себя', oneself). Used as an perfective (single completed action) verb meaning 'to come back, to return', paired with 'возвращаться'.

examples.text: Так, не шумим. Я скоро вернусь.
examples.trans: Right, no noise. I'll be back soon.

meanings.note: трезвый водитель = designated / sober driver service

examples.trans: The bus driver opened the doors.

examples.text: Ты же не помнишь ничего. Ты вызвал трезвого водителя!
examples.trans: You don't remember anything, after all. You called a sober driver!

examples.text: Давай мы его уволим, а тебя на его место назначим.

meanings.note: + infinitive; agrees with the subject: должна (f)
Prefix 'до-' marks reaching a boundary or finishing the remainder of an action (stem 'лжен'). Agrees in gender, number, and case with the noun it modifies ('must, should; owe').

examples.text: Жадность, Паша, должна быть умеренная. Комнатной температуры.
examples.trans: Greed, Pasha, should be moderate. Room temperature.

meanings.note: Contrast дома = at home. Core Russian adv meaning '(to) home, homeward' in everyday speech.

examples.text: А ты иди домой и делай уроки.
examples.trans: And you go home and do your homework.

examples.text: Так, мы идём к слепым. А ты иди домой и делай уроки.
examples.trans: Right, we're going to the blind people. And you go home and do your homework.

meanings.note: в кухне / на кухне = in the kitchen, на кухню = to the kitchen
E.g. русская кухня. Entered Russian via Polish 'kuchnia' and Middle High German 'küchen', ultimately from Late Latin 'coquina' (from 'coquere', to cook).
